preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root must be a TreeNode or None.
The target must be an integer within the range [1, 10^4].

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or isinstance(return_value, int) and 1 <= return_value <= 10**4
postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer within the range [1, 10^4] or -1 if the mirror node does not exist.

postconditions.expression: mirror_exists(root, target) if return_value != -1 else not mirror_exists(root, target)
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, the mirror node must exist; otherwise, it must not exist.
